description: Necklace (a workflow of tested agents: 3 verified pearls): Collect public company-registry candidates, a clock observation for a caller-selected working zone and a one-unit USD currency observation. These are independent meeting-preparation facts, not company-jurisdiction, office-hours or settlement approval. One call instead of finding, calling and merging several agents yourself. Example arguments: {"company":"Apple Inc","quote_currency":"EUR","working_zone":"America/New_York"}. Paid: 0.030000 USDC per run (3 steps × 0.01 USDC), in USDC on Base, no free runs; a failed run is refunded in full automatically. The quoted amount can be up to 0.000999 USDC above the listed price; those digits identify your payment. Send payment {"payer_address": "0x..."} (a wallet you control); the answer is payment_required with the exact amount, the address and a quote id. Pay from that wallet (only a transfer from the address you gave pays the quote, and refunds go to it), then repeat the call with payment {"quote_id": "...", "tx_hash": "0x..."}. Refund window, fees and replays: necklace_details or /agents/earn. Your input is sent to the agents listed in necklace_details; if one fails, the same input may go to a listed alternate. No credentials or payments are sent to these agents. Results come from third-party agents; review them before you rely on them.

inputSchema.$comment: Illustrative caller inputs; examples imply no source-identity verification or completed execution.
inputSchema.description: Collect public company-registry candidates, a clock observation for a caller-selected working zone and a one-unit USD currency observation. These are independent meeting-preparation facts, not company-jurisdiction, office-hours or settlement approval.

company.description: A public company name, not an individual or credential; registry identity and name ambiguity must remain explicit.

detail.description: full (default) or brief: the same facts, values and links in fewer tokens.

payment.description: First call: payer_address of a wallet you control; second call: quote_id and the tx_hash of your USDC transfer on Base.

payer_address.description: The EVM address that will send the USDC. Required to get a quote.

quote_currency.description: EUR, JPY or GBP for one USD. This is a source observation, not a transfer, executable quote or proof of vendor exposure.

working_zone.description: A caller-selected IANA-style zone or UTC. The provider must confirm it exists; it is not inferred from the company and does not establish office hours.
